articles.title: Simone Biles’s unusual complaint about her husband Jonathan Owens: ‘It’s a Level 5!’
articles.standfirst: The Olympic champion joked about her husband’s clingy side as she continues to support him during his latest NFL chapter
articles.summary: The Olympic champion joked about her husband’s clingy side as she continues to support him during his latest NFL chapter
articles.body:
S imone Biles and Jonathan Owens have never been the sort of couple to hide their affection from the public, but the Olympic gymnastics icon recently offered fans another glimpse into their relationship with a playful complaint about her husband.

Biles jokingly suggested that Owens had reached an entirely different level of attachment, describing him as a “Level 5 clinger” when discussing how closely he sticks by her side.

The comment came as the couple spent time together around Owens' preparations for the 2026 NFL season.

The veteran safety is entering another season in professional football after signing with the Indianapolis Colts in March, giving Biles another opportunity to embrace her familiar role as a supportive football wife.

Owens ' move to Indianapolis represents another chapter in a career that has taken an unconventional route.

He entered the NFL as an undrafted free agent and has since played for the Houston Texans , Green Bay Packers and Chicago Bears before joining the Colts. Indianapolis signed him to a one-year contract in March.

Biles has made it clear that she is proud of how Owens has built his career despite not hearing his name called during the NFL Draft.

His journey from Missouri Western State to becoming an established NFL safety has been based largely on persistence and repeated opportunities.

And the gymnast has continued to be one of his most visible supporters.

Biles and Owens continue to share their relationship with fans

The couple recently gave followers another look at their relationship when Biles visited Owens at Colts practice on August 17.

The seven-time Olympic gold medalist shared footage of the pair spending time together at the practice facility, including affectionate moments and a kiss.

She also posted additional images and videos from their time together, showing that even with Owens beginning another NFL campaign, the couple are finding opportunities to remain close.

Biles' latest joke therefore fits into a much broader pattern. The couple frequently document vacations, celebrations and everyday moments together, often mixing affectionate posts with humour.

Their relationship has also weathered considerably more intense public scrutiny.

Owens and Biles first connected on the dating app Raya in 2020 and married in 2023. Their relationship received another wave of attention after Owens made controversial comments about their early dating experience during a 2023 appearance on The Pivot podcast.

Among his remarks was his claim that he was “the catch,” while he also said he initially did not know who Biles was. The comments prompted substantial criticism online.

Despite that controversy, Biles has consistently demonstrated that the couple's relationship is their own.

Their public interactions in 2026 have generally painted a picture of two athletes who remain deeply supportive of one another.

Biles has attended football-related events for Owens , while the NFL safety has supported his wife through her own professional and personal challenges.

Earlier this summer, Biles also revealed that she had experienced a serious health scare while Owens was away at Colts activities.

She described it as “one of, if not the scariest experience of my life” and said she was recovering at home. Owens later accompanied her during a subsequent medical procedure, although the couple have kept the details of her condition private.

That makes the lighter “Level 5” complaint particularly fitting for a couple whose lives frequently put them in the spotlight.

Owens is now preparing for another NFL season, while Biles continues to navigate life away from regular gymnastics competition after establishing herself as the most decorated gymnast in history.

For all the professional demands surrounding them, however, their social-media appearances suggest that spending time together remains a major part of their lives.

And if Biles' latest joke is anything to go by, Owens may be more than happy to stay close to his wife whenever his football schedule allows it.

articles.title: Simone Biles turns heads with the look she chose to support Jonathan Owens and the Colts
articles.standfirst: The gymnast made another appearance during the NFL preseason.
articles.summary: The gymnast made another appearance during the NFL preseason.
articles.body:
Simone Biles arrived at Lucas Oil Stadium to support Jonathan Owens during the preseason matchup between the Indianapolis Colts and Atlanta Falcons , marking one of her early appearances since her husband began his stint with Indianapolis. This time, however, it was the gymnast’s laid-back look that caught much of the attention.

Cargo pants and a Colts top

Biles built her outfit around two main pieces: black cargo pants and a cropped Colts top .

She kept the rest of the look in the same relaxed style, pairing it with a black bag and wearing her long braids.

Biles’ look had a second chapter that appeared later on social media.

In a video shared by the woman responsible for her glam, fans got a closer look at her makeup, including black eyeliner and defined lips that completed the look .

The images also showed Simone wearing a white shirt and several accessories, including a necklace featuring the word “Owens.”

Atlanta spoiled Indianapolis’ night

The game’s final result was very different from the image Biles presented from the stands.

The Atlanta Falcons defeated the Colts 34-6 . Indianapolis struggled to generate offense, with its only points coming on two field goals by Spencer Shrader.

Jonathan Owens recorded one tackle during the game as he continues competing for a place in Indianapolis’ defense ahead of the regular season.

Her braids fell past her waist, while her smile and relaxed energy made her one of the most noticeable faces on the sideline.

As always, Biles made it clear that supporting her husband is part of her game-day routine—and she knows how to do it in style.

articles.title: Simone Biles switched jerseys again: Is she an NFL fan or just a fan of whichever team Jonathan Owens plays for?
articles.standfirst: The legend of Olympic gymnastics once again drew all eyes in the NFL stands by debuting the colors of the Indianapolis Colts.
articles.summary: The legend of Olympic gymnastics once again drew all eyes in the NFL stands by debuting the colors of the Indianapolis Colts.
articles.body:
Jonathan Owens began a new chapter in Indianapolis, and Simone Biles already has a new favorite team. At least for this season. The gymnast appeared on August 22 at Lucas Oil Stadium to accompany her husband during the preseason game between the Indianapolis Colts and the Atlanta Falcons.

Her choice of outfit made it clear that she is already settled into her husband's new chapter. She wore a cropped Colts top, black pants, and a Chanel purse. As usual, she shared a kiss with Owens before the game.

Her husband's games often become an ideal stage for Simone to show off her looks. During his time with the Bears , her appearances were especially eye-catching and even included custom-made garments. In past seasons, the athlete has worn handmade jackets featuring her husband's face, themed footwear, and fine jewelry highlighting the player's jersey number.

This is the fifth time the gymnast has adjusted her outfit due to strategic moves in the NFL market.

Her love story with American football began in 2020 with the Houston Texans , the team where Owens was playing when they met through a dating app. At that time, Biles openly admitted that she had no prior knowledge of or particular interest in the sport.

At this moment, the color scheme that currently predominates is blue and white, corresponding to the Indianapolis Colts . For this new chapter in Indiana, fans are already eagerly waiting to see what new exclusive designs she will unveil at official games. articles.title: Jonathan Owens' hesitation in his first big decision with the Colts creates a major problem for Simone Biles
articles.standfirst: Owens’ jersey number uncertainty left Biles without the key detail she needed for another custom game-day look
articles.summary: Owens’ jersey number uncertainty left Biles without the key detail she needed for another custom game-day look
articles.body:
Simone Biles' first Colts game-day appearance looked noticeably different from the fashion statements she became known for during her time in Chicago.

When the Olympic champion arrived at Lucas Oil Stadium to support her husband, Jonathan Owens , during the Colts' preseason matchup with the Atlanta Falcons, she chose an understated look that suggested a new chapter was beginning in Indianapolis.

Biles wore a cropped black Colts tank top with oversized black cargo-style pants and flat shoes.

She completed the outfit with a quilted Chanel mini bag and plenty of jewelry, including a diamond-encrusted “Owens” necklace, a watch, a pinky ring, a hand chain and diamond huggie earrings.

While the overall outfit was simple, her accessories kept the personal touch fans have come to expect from her game-day appearances.

During Owens ' two seasons with the Chicago Bears, Biles regularly wore custom pieces designed around her husband, including jeans featuring his name and eye-catching outfits incorporating his jersey number.

One of her most memorable looks included custom red No. 36 pants paired with a cropped white fur jacket.

Her Chicago outfits frequently attracted attention online, so her first appearance supporting Owens in Indianapolis naturally raised expectations.

Owens' jersey number decision forced Biles to play it safe

There was, however, a practical reason Biles didn't arrive in another elaborate custom outfit. Owens was still deciding which jersey number he'd wear with the Colts.

Biles explained that she hadn't ordered anything custom because her husband's number hadn't been finalized. That left her unable to build an outfit around his new Colts identity without risking a last-minute change.

The decision eventually became official: Owens will wear No. 38 in Indianapolis, a change from the No. 36 he wore with Chicago. The Colts' official roster lists the veteran safety as No. 38, giving Biles the information she needs for future game-day fashion.

“Sorry to disappoint. I didn’t get anything custom-made for this game because Jonathan was still deciding between numbers. It’s official. He’ll be wearing number 38 this season,” she wrote.

That hesitation might seem minor, but it created a fashion problem for Biles . Her personalized NFL outfits have become part of her public image, and the jersey number often serves as the centerpiece of those designs.

Until Owens settled on No. 38, creating another custom piece simply didn't make much sense.

Still, Biles found other ways to celebrate the move. Earlier in August, she shared a sweet moment with Owens on the field during Colts practice, captioning the post with a message about their relationship and welcoming the return of football season.

Her first Colts appearance also came on a difficult night for the team. Atlanta cruised to a 34-6 victory, leaving Indianapolis struggling to generate much offense. Owens recorded one tackle in the preseason contest.

articles.title: Anthony Richardson Trade Rumor: Top 3 landing spots for the former No. 4 overall pick by the Colts
articles.standfirst: The highly drafted Indianapolis Colts quarterback has fallen completely out of favor, even with Daniel Jones coming off of an Achilles injury.
articles.summary: The highly drafted Indianapolis Colts quarterback has fallen completely out of favor, even with Daniel Jones coming off of an Achilles injury.
articles.body:
When the Indianapolis Colts made Anthony Richardson the fourth overall pick in the 2023 NFL Draft , it was very much considered a high-risk, high-reward selection. Two years into Richardson's NFL career, the arrow was pointing to the risky part rearing its ugly head. Then came the 2025 season, which turned into an utter disaster for the young QB .

Veteran Daniel Jones handily beat out Richardson in the Colts' quarterback competition, then proceeded to turn Indy's offense into one of the best in the league. Jones ended up tearing his Achilles in early December, but by that point, Richardson was on injured reserve due to a fractured orbital bone suffered during a pregame warmup on October 13 .

Teams calling Indianapolis Colts with hopes of trading for Anthony Richardson

Heading into the 2026 season, Jones has rehabbed well and comes in as the clear-cut starter. While many might assume Richardson will be the backup, Riley Leonard is competing with him for the second-string job . As it turns out, that competition might not end up having a conclusion.

That's because a report from Benjamin Allbright suggests Richardson could be on the move "in the next few weeks", as teams have called the Colts with interest in trading for him . With that in mind, these three teams could make sense for Richardson and would be the best potential fits when considering his short-term and long-term future.

The New York Jets have been starving for quarterbacks for quite a while. They're heading into the 2026 season with much-maligned Geno Smith as the starter, while fourth round pick Cade Klubnik is the backup. With Smith on a one-year contract, Richardson could set himself up to compete for the starting job in 2027 there.

Baker Mayfield is fully entrenched as the starting QB, but the Tampa Bay Buccaneers have refused to commit to him with a long-term contract that he was asking for this offseason. With really only Jake Browning behind Mayfield, Richardson could easily win the second-string job this season and replace Mayfield in 2027 if everything goes perfectly.

The Atlanta Falcons have a quarterback conundrum of their own. Michael Penix Jr. hasn't shown much so far in his NFL career, and Tua Tagovailoa has been terrible in preseason - and could be traded away soon. There would be an easy pathway for Richardson to make a name for himself in Atlanta.

articles.title: Colts star Keenan Allen arrested for driving under the influence in Indianapolis
articles.standfirst: Six-time Pro Bowler was taken into custody early Sunday morning in downtown Indianapolis
articles.summary: Six-time Pro Bowler was taken into custody early Sunday morning in downtown Indianapolis
articles.body:
Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was arrested early Sunday morning in downtown Indianapolis on preliminary charges related to driving while intoxicated, putting an unexpected cloud over the veteran receiver's first week with his new team.

Allen , 34, was taken into custody at approximately 1 a.m. ET after Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department officers conducted a traffic investigation in the 100 block of South Meridian Street.

Police said officers encountered a vehicle parked in a no-parking zone and noticed signs of intoxication during their interaction with Allen .

According to Marion County jail records, Allen faces two misdemeanor allegations. They involve operating a vehicle while intoxicated while endangering another person and operating a vehicle while intoxicated with an alcohol concentration of 0.08 or higher.

The charges are preliminary allegations, and Allen hasn't been convicted of either offense. He was being held at the Marion County Arrestee Processing Center following the arrest.

The incident happened only hours after Allen made his first appearance in a Colts uniform. Indianapolis hosted the Detroit Lions in its preseason finale Saturday, with Allen playing briefly and catching one pass for 24 yards. The Colts ultimately lost 25-16.

Colts await more information on Allen's situation

The arrest comes less than two weeks after Indianapolis added Allen on a one-year contract. The move was designed to give the Colts another experienced weapon at wide receiver as they prepare for the 2026 regular season.

Allen enters his 14th NFL season with an impressive résumé. A six-time Pro Bowl selection, he has amassed 1,055 receptions for 12,051 yards and 70 touchdowns during his career.

He spent the first 11 seasons of his professional career with the Chargers before joining the Chicago Bears in 2024. He returned to Los Angeles last season and recorded 81 catches for 777 yards and four touchdowns.

His experience has made him a notable addition to an Indianapolis receiving group that could benefit from another established target. However, Sunday's arrest now leaves the Colts with an off-field situation to address as the regular season approaches.

The team has acknowledged the incident but hasn't announced any disciplinary action. In a statement, the Colts said they're aware of what happened and are gathering additional information, declining to comment further for now.

Allen's situation remains developing, and any potential impact on his availability or standing with Indianapolis will likely depend on the legal process and additional information that emerges. The Colts are scheduled to open their regular season against the Baltimore Ravens on September 13.

articles.title: Simone Biles embarrasses Jonathan Owens after unexpected moment before the Colts game
articles.summary: Simone Biles hasn’t missed a Colts game and was once again on the field to support Jonathan Owens and give him some good luck before kickoff. But this time, Biles put Owens in an awkward spot, and it was clear he was a little embarrassed by the moment. The couple’s pregame handshake has almost become a ritual, usually ending with Owens giving Simone a playful tap on the butt. However, this time, Owens tried to skip that final gesture because Biles’ brother was also on the field with her, and he apparently felt it wasn’t appropriate to do it in front of him. Simone, meanwhile, seemed more than ready for the usual gesture and even insisted on keeping the ritual going, making the moment even more awkward for Owens.

articles.summary: Biles wanted to keep their pregame ritual going, but Owens wasn’t so sure this time
articles.body:
Simone Biles has never hidden the closeness she shares with Jonathan Owens. On social media, she has made it clear that physical touch is part of her love language, and during her appearances on the sideline before games, she often uses that same language to give Owens some good luck.

Since Biles took over social media and fully embraced her WAG era, their interactions have often ended with a small tap or even a squeeze . This time, however, Owens felt embarrassed in the moment and chose to skip that final step before his game with the Colts.

The handshake suddenly became a little more complicated

Biles wasn’t afraid to keep the tradition going, but Owens appeared uncomfortable with the gesture because she wasn’t alone on the field. Her brother was also there , so Jonathan opted for just a cool handshake and awkwardly skipped the tap on Biles’ butt in front of her family.

What was just another normal moment for Biles before her husband’s game was not seen the same way by Owens or her brother, who found themselves caught in the middle of the awkward situation that fans found genuinely amusing.

Owens recently signed a one-year contract with the Indianapolis Colts and has played in all three preseason games, so the family is settling in for a year in the city. Simone Biles, the safety’s wife, attended the Colts’ 34-6 home defeat to the Atlanta Falcons on Saturday.

Biles’ brother has already joined her for another Indiana sporting event

This is not the first time Biles’ brother has been spotted alongside the gymnast. The two were recently seen in the Indiana Fever tunnel supporting Caitlin Clark. Now that Indiana is their home with the Colts, they took the opportunity to attend a WNBA game together and watch one of the league’s most famous franchises.

articles.title: Colts’ Tyler Warren gives team intern the biggest surprise of her life on the practice field
articles.standfirst: The Indianapolis Colts tight end was at the center of a viral social media moment.
articles.summary: The Indianapolis Colts tight end was at the center of a viral social media moment.
articles.body:
The 2026 NFL season is rapidly approaching. Coaching staffs all across the league are getting their players prepared, front offices are keeping an eye on available players to see how they can improve the roster, and those working for NFL franchises are as busy as ever.

A lot of times, the people working behind the scenes go unnoticed, and under-appreciated. Whether it be the marketing department, sales team, or social media group, everyone pitches in to make sure the season becomes a success. The Indianapolis Colts seem to understand that very well.

On Tuesday, the team made sure to show appreciation for a social media intern who has put in the hard work. Tight end Tyler Warren took the liberty of surprising the intern with truly fantastic news.

Indianapolis Colts intern gets promoted and finds out in awesome way

Warren approached the intern, who was filming him for content, and handed her a piece of paper. On it read, “ Promotion to Full-Time Employee, Valid for One Use Only. Officially Validated by: Tyler Warren .”

The intern was stunned and got emotional. Meanwhile, her coworkers and some players came up to her to congratulate her on her promotion . It was a heartwarming moment for the organization.

articles.title: Simone Biles shows the moment that confirms Jonathan Owens is ready for the NFL
articles.standfirst: The gymnast shared several glimpses of her husband before the safety begins a new chapter with the Indianapolis Colts.
articles.summary: The gymnast shared several glimpses of her husband before the safety begins a new chapter with the Indianapolis Colts.
articles.body:
S imone Biles took advantage of the final hours before the NFL returns to share a very personal glimpse of Jonathan Owens . Between moments as a couple, scenes from home and a relaxed afternoon, the gymnast offered a look at how her husband is spending the days leading up to a season that will mark a new chapter in his career.

Simone Biles showed her more relaxed side with Jonathan Owens

One of the stories showed Simone and Jonathan inside a car, both smiling as they enjoyed the moment together. The scene conveyed that sense of calm that often comes just before the sports schedule picks up again .

Later, Biles shared another image with the pool in the background and a sunset that completed the laid-back atmosphere of their final days of rest.

For a few hours, football seemed far away. Jonathan was simply enjoying time at home and his wife's company before returning to a routine filled with practices, travel and games .

But then a photo appeared that made everything fall into place.

A photo of Jonathan Owens says it all

In one of the images, Jonathan appeared walking with his luggage. Without a uniform and far from any stadium, the photo offered a pretty clear hint about what is about to begin: the NFL season is just around the corner .

And this time, Owens' football destination will be different from where he spent the previous two seasons.

Jonathan Owens enters 2026 with a new team

The 30-year-old safety will play the 2026 season with the Indianapolis Colts after his two-year contract with the Chicago Bears ended , making him an unrestricted free agent.

In March of this year, Owens signed with Indianapolis for one season and $1.402 million, including a $187,500 guaranteed signing bonus . The Colts added a veteran who can provide depth in the secondary and experience on special teams.

His final year in Chicago was particularly tied to that second unit. Owens appeared in all 17 regular-season games in 2025 and recorded 19 combined tackles on special teams, while playing just 4% of the team's defensive snaps .

Now, he will have the opportunity to start fresh with Indianapolis, just as the new season is about to begin.

Simone Biles will be watching every game again

The change of teams also means a new setting from which Simone will support her husband throughout the season.

Biles and Owens began dating in 2020 and officially married in April 2023 . Since then, the gymnast has shown her support for the NFL player on multiple occasions throughout his career.

Now, their story will have a new setting at Lucas Oil Stadium , where the Colts will host the Baltimore Ravens this Sunday, September 13, to begin their 2026 regular season .

articles.title: Not even Simone Biles’ “good luck” charm could save the Colts from disaster in Jonathan Owens’ debut
articles.standfirst: Simone Biles joined her husband at the start of a new chapter with a very special gesture, but Indianapolis ultimately fell to the Ravens.
articles.summary: Simone Biles joined her husband at the start of a new chapter with a very special gesture, but Indianapolis ultimately fell to the Ravens.
articles.body:
T he Indianapolis Colts did not enter the 2026 season as one of the biggest names in the AFC South . The year before, they finished with 8 wins and 9 losses, a record that kept them out of the playoffs and left them in third place in the division, behind the Jacksonville Jaguars and Houston Texans .

So the debut against the Baltimore Ravens did not exactly make Indianapolis the clear favorite. It was simply the beginning of a new season and, with it, an opportunity to change the team’s story. Because if there is one thing you expect from a season opener, it is at least a sign that things could get better.

For Jonathan Owens , there was also a personal reason to look forward to Sunday.

Jonathan Owens was making his Colts debut

After two seasons with the Chicago Bears , Owens arrived in Indianapolis to begin a new chapter in the NFL. In 2024, he played in all 17 games, making five starts, recording 46 tackles and one interception , while also contributing to a special teams play that ended in a touchdown after a blocked punt.

His situation changed the following year. He again appeared in all 17 games, but did not start any of them and finished with 19 total tackles . His arrival in Indianapolis, then, represented an opportunity to find an important role again within a secondary that needed depth.

And on a day like this, Simone Biles was not going to miss it.

Simone showed up wearing No. 38

Before kickoff at Lucas Oil Stadium, Simone was on one of the areas of the field wearing a look that immediately carried special meaning for Jonathan . She had on a blue dress with the number 38 , the same number her husband was debuting with the Colts, along with white boots and her hair down.

Jonathan, already dressed in his Indianapolis uniform, ran toward her. They shared a kiss, exchanged a few words, and Simone showed him the detail on her dress . Then came their personalized greeting, one of those playful moments that made the scene feel even more like them.

There was another detail that made the image even more special: they were both wearing Colts colors to begin this new chapter. He was about to play his first official game with the team; she was there on the field supporting him and wearing his number like a personal good-luck charm.

Everything seemed ready for a good afternoon.

But the game had other plans .

Baltimore changed the story very quickly

The Colts, in fact, got off to a positive start. On their first offensive drive, Jonathan Taylor scored a one-yard rushing touchdown to put Indianapolis ahead 6-0 , although the team missed the extra point.

The lead did not last long.

Lamar Jackson responded with a five-yard rushing touchdown, and Derrick Henry added another rushing score, this time from four yards out. Baltimore began finding space far too easily, and by the second quarter, the difference was becoming impossible to ignore.

First came Zay Flowers’ touchdown, followed by another big play from Henry, who ran 32 yards into the end zone. The Ravens went up 28-6, while Indianapolis tried to stay in the game with Taylor’s second touchdown .

Before halftime, there was another blow: Tyler Loop converted a 57-yard field goal, giving Baltimore a 31-13 lead heading into the locker room.

The scene with Simone before the game already seemed like it belonged to a completely different afternoon.

Not even No. 38 could change the result

Indianapolis tried to respond after halftime, and a 58-yard field goal from Spencer Shrader cut into the deficit. But the Colts never got close enough to truly put Baltimore’s lead in danger.

Henry appeared again in the fourth quarter with his third rushing touchdown of the game , and the exchange of scores in the final minutes completed the scoreboard.

For Jonathan Owens, his official debut with Indianapolis ended with one combined tackle.

And so, what had started with Simone Biles running toward her husband , followed by a kiss and a greeting between the two, ended with a completely different outcome than anyone would have imagined for the first game of this new chapter.

Now comes another challenge

The loss does not define what the Colts will become throughout the entire season, but it does make their opener a particularly difficult first test. Indianapolis will have to respond quickly because Week 2 is already on the horizon.

The next game will be Sunday, September 20, 2026, when the Colts travel to face the Kansas City Chiefs at Arrowhead Stadium .

articles.title: Simone Biles opens up about masked men stealing from her home in Chicago
articles.standfirst: A new car pickup turned into a shocking revelation about one of Biles’ final days in Chicago
articles.summary: A new car pickup turned into a shocking revelation about one of Biles’ final days in Chicago
articles.body:
What started as a GRWM TikTok with Simone Biles excited to pick up her new car ended with the Olympic gymnast revealing something she had kept private . Biles explained that during her final days in Chicago, when Jonathan Owens was still with the Bears, three masked men broke into her home and stole her Porsche GTS.

Biles has previously said that while she spends more time on social media now, she remains selective about what she chooses to share . This time, she decided to open up about the incident while getting ready to buy another car , giving fans a glimpse into an experience she had never publicly detailed.

The incident also played a role in a big decision

Biles revealed that the robbery was one of the reasons she and Owens decided to get a Doberman . The breed is known for being protective, and the decision came after the gymnast no longer felt as secure following what happened at their Chicago home.

She did not reveal the incident when it happened, but said she may share more details about the robbery at some point . For now, the gymnast only explained that three masked men entered the home and took her Porsche GTS , an experience that remained private until now.

Biles says her life has enough material for a reality show

The latest revelation comes after what Biles described as a chaotic few months . She suggested that if her life were turned into a reality show, producers would have plenty of material to work with, referencing the different events she has experienced recently, including a hospital visit for a medical emergency a few months ago.

Despite losing her previous Porsche, Biles has decided to buy another Porsche SUV because she loves the vehicle's power and did not let the theft change how she feels about the car . Now, with her Doberman, a new city and a positive attitude, Biles is starting another chapter that already has enough twists to feel like a Hollywood movie.

articles.title: Jonathan Owens makes candid admission about early stages of Simone Biles relationship
articles.standfirst: The NFL player and gymnastics Olympian have been together since 2020, and married in 2023.
articles.summary: The NFL player and gymnastics Olympian have been together since 2020, and married in 2023.
articles.body:
As a professional football player who has been in the NFL since 2018, Jonathan Owens already knew what being in the public eye was like before he even met Simone Biles . But once the NFL safety and Olympic gold medalist began dating, everything was taken to a whole other level for Owens.

By 2020, Owens wasn't yet a known commodity in the football world , still trying to carve out a role as a special teams ace with the flexibility to step in in defensive situations if called upon. That year, he met Biles and the spotlight was on him like never before . That didn't affect his on-field performance; in fact, it seemed to make him better.

Owens began earning defensive reps in 2021 with the Houston Texans , then became a full-time starter in 2022. He then signed with the Green Bay Packers in 2023 and the Chicago Bears the year after, playing in all 17 games from 2022 to 2025. Biles was there every step of the way. Owens used her presence as a plus, but it wasn't always easy .

Jonathan Owens had a tough time adjusting to so much fame with Simone Biles by his side

In a recent interview with The Athletic , Owens candidly admitted that the early stages of his relationship with Biles were tough, as he had to adjust to newfound fame that he wasn't familiar with .

It was tough at first because I'm a pretty quiet, private person. It almost makes you a shell of yourself, at first, because of all the criticism. They've got something to say about everything you do. ​ ​That was my first time of really, really being in the public eye and people trying to hate on you — 'Oh, you're Mr. Biles!' — and stuff like that. But that's what comes with it. You take the good with the bad, and at the end of the day, I'm living my dream.

Owens referenced his controversial statement in 2023 when he said that " men are the catch " during an interview. His comment drew a lot of backlash, flinging him into the unwanted limelight.

Since then, Owens has seemingly welcomed the spotlight, whether it be positive or negative.

articles.title: Simone Biles and Jonathan Owens make painful decision that'll earn them more than $1 million
articles.standfirst: Their former Spring property played an important role in the couple’s relationship before their dream home was completed
articles.summary: Their former Spring property played an important role in the couple’s relationship before their dream home was completed
articles.body:
S imone Biles is preparing to leave behind a home that represented a significant milestone in her life long before she and Jonathan Owens completed their sprawling dream property outside Houston . The Olympic gymnastics legend has listed her four-bedroom home in Spring, Texas , for $1.2 million after six years of ownership. Biles bought the property in 2020 while she and Owens were dating, and it later became part of their life together before and after their April 2023 wedding.

Now the couple has somewhere very different to call home as their long-awaited custom lakefront mansion was completed in November 2025 after years of planning and construction. That has allowed Biles and Owens to move on from the Spring property and into the residence they designed together, but their first home came with plenty of luxury to keep the pair happy. Built in 2019, the residence spans 3,998 square feet and includes four bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and a three-car garage, sitting on more than an acre of land, the contemporary property was designed with entertaining in mind. High ceilings and large windows dominate the interior, while other features include a modern fireplace, media room, private study and custom wine wall as the kitchen includes quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, a waterfall island and hidden pantry. Outside, there is a pool and substantial private space, while the home also includes a dedicated washing and feeding station for pets. Yet the significance of the property went beyond its amenities.

Biles was heavily involved in the design process

Spring was the first home Biles purchased herself and became one of the places where her relationship with Owens developed and their dream mansion took years to complete as the pair began designing their larger Houston-area home in 2020. Construction eventually started in February 2022, and the finished lakefront property includes a large kitchen, home theater, game room, wet bar, swimming pool and spa, basketball court and dedicated areas for their dogs. The Olympic gymnastics legend has listed her four-bedroom home in Spring, Texas , for $1.2 million after six years of ownership. Biles bought the property in 2020 while she and Owens were dating, and it later became part of their life together before and after their April 2023 wedding.

Now the couple has somewhere very different to call home as their long-awaited custom lakefront mansion was completed in November 2025 after years of planning and construction. That has allowed Biles and Owens to move on from the Spring property and into the residence they designed together, but their first home came with plenty of luxury to keep the pair happy. Built in 2019, the residence spans 3,998 square feet and includes four bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and a three-car garage, sitting on more than an acre of land, the contemporary property was designed with entertaining in mind. High ceilings and large windows dominate the interior, while other features include a modern fireplace, media room, private study and custom wine wall as the kitchen includes quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, a waterfall island and hidden pantry. Outside, there is a pool and substantial private space, while the home also includes a dedicated washing and feeding station for pets. Yet the significance of the property went beyond its amenities.
